q: Who was the first Governor-General of India (not of Bengal)?
x: The Charter Act of 1833 made the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of India; William Bentinck was the first. Warren Hastings was the first Governor-General of Bengal.

q: Who was the first Viceroy of India?
x: After the Government of India Act 1858, Lord Canning became the first Viceroy.

q: Which Viceroy is called the father of local self-government in India?
x: Lord Ripon's resolution of 1882 laid the base for local self-government.

q: The Vernacular Press Act was passed by ___ and repealed by ___.
x: Lord Lytton passed the "gagging Act" in 1878; Lord Ripon repealed it in 1882.

q: Which Act brought dyarchy in the provinces?
x: The 1919 Act (Montagu–Chelmsford reforms) split provincial subjects into reserved and transferred. The 1935 Act brought dyarchy at the Centre.

q: Which Act first gave separate electorates to Muslims?
x: The Morley–Minto reforms of 1909 introduced separate electorates for Muslims.

q: What is called the Magna Carta of English education in India?
x: Charles Wood's Despatch of 1854 laid out education from primary school to university.

q: Who started the Mahalwari system of land revenue?
x: Holt Mackenzie, 1822. Cornwallis brought the Permanent Settlement (1793); Munro and Read the Ryotwari system.

q: Who was the first woman president of the Indian National Congress?
x: Annie Besant (Calcutta, 1917). Sarojini Naidu (Kanpur, 1925) was the first Indian woman president.

q: Who led the 1857 revolt at Jagdishpur in Bihar?
x: Kunwar Singh, then about 80 years old, led the revolt in Bihar.

q: Who founded the Servants of India Society in 1905?
x: Gokhale founded it in Pune in 1905 to train people for national service.
Maulana Azad started Al-Hilal in 1912. Mohammad Ali edited Comrade.
Utkal Dipika was started in 1866 by Gourishankar Ray at Cuttack.

q: Under which Viceroy was the shift of the capital from Calcutta to Delhi announced?
x: It was announced at the Delhi Durbar of 1911, during Lord Hardinge's time.

q: Which Congress session passed the resolution on Fundamental Rights?
x: Karachi, 1931, presided by Sardar Patel. Lahore 1929 passed Purna Swaraj.

q: Who was the first president of the All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC)?
x: Lala Lajpat Rai presided over AITUC's founding in 1920.
